g.desc: threshold ~4 V while the watchdog runs

g.text: timer 1: needs MCU pulses AND front panel (ARM low)

g.desc: timer 1: needs MCU pulses AND front panel (ARM low)

g.text: a relay closes only if EVERY input is high; any input low drops the AND node

g.desc: a relay closes only if EVERY input is high; any input low drops the AND node

g.text: NOTES (structure confirmed by continuity; MCU port types from the uPD78F0034 datasheet p.11; ? = value not read)

g.desc: NOTES (structure confirmed by continuity; MCU port types from the uPD78F0034 datasheet p.11; ? = value not read)

g.text: - MCU pins 11-14 (P30-P33) are N-channel OPEN-DRAIN: they can only pull a line low, or read it. PERMIT1/2 are pulled DOWN by R542/R706, so only IC700 (through D707/D706)

g.desc: - MCU pins 11-14 (P30-P33) are N-channel OPEN-DRAIN: they can only pull a line low, or read it. PERMIT1/2 are pulled DOWN by R542/R706, so only IC700 (through D707/D706)

g.text: can hold them high. A dead or disconnected detector therefore removes the permit (fail-safe). The MCU can veto (pull low) and read them.

g.desc: can hold them high. A dead or disconnected detector therefore removes the permit (fail-safe). The MCU can veto (pull low) and read them.

g.text: - VGATE: the 3 x 47 kohm network (RX15, RX16, RX17) feeds Q205 from BOTH AND nodes, so the IGBT drivers are powered only while both mains relays are permitted.

g.desc: - VGATE: the 3 x 47 kohm network (RX15, RX16, RX17) feeds Q205 from BOTH AND nodes, so the IGBT drivers are powered only while both mains relays are permitted.

g.text: - Watchdog: timer 1 time-out ~0.45 x R548 x 22 uF, timer 2 ~0.45 x 1 Mohm x C514. Q_EMIT: D225/D226 raise the relay drivers' turn-on threshold; series/parallel not certain.

g.desc: - Watchdog: timer 1 time-out ~0.45 x R548 x 22 uF, timer 2 ~0.45 x 1 Mohm x C514. Q_EMIT: D225/D226 raise the relay drivers' turn-on threshold; series/parallel not certain.

g.text: - IC700: D702/D703 feed each output back to its own + input (latch). Half A's threshold comes from WD1, so the latch clears when the watchdog restarts.

g.desc: - IC700: D702/D703 feed each output back to its own + input (latch). Half A's threshold comes from WD1, so the latch clears when the watchdog restarts.

g.text: APPROXIMATE: the sensed signals (via D601/R708 and the JC3 path) were only partly traced. Most likely role: heater current while the triac should be off (error 69).

g.desc: APPROXIMATE: the sensed signals (via D601/R708 and the JC3 path) were only partly traced. Most likely role: heater current while the triac should be off (error 69).

g.text: LATCHING FAULT COMPARATORS (IC700 TLC277): the only source that can hold the permits high

g.desc: LATCHING FAULT COMPARATORS (IC700 TLC277): the only source that can hold the permits high
